Leading kept chunk starts at 12, so VP8X type is 12..16, length 16..20, payload[0] at 20 (walk payload at at+8). len>20 makes out[20] in-bounds; a lone empty VP8X is exactly 20 bytes and is skipped. Size at 16..20 is never read. size 0 has no pad (span=8), so a later kept chunk starts at 20; VP8X is kept and counts as picture, and &= !(0x08|0x04) then edits the next FourCC ('V' 0x56→0x52). Truncation never reaches 129: walk returns None. The 10-byte case in the test is the one where out[20] is the flags byte.

No Date.now/new Date. Same commit yields the same SHA and UTC committer date, so this file does not make CF vs Netlify manifest bytes diverge.
